data.name: Chayana
data.gender_notes: Chayana is used as a unisex name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The name Chayana is derived from the Sanskrit word 'Chaya', which means 'shadow' or 'moon'. In Hindu mythology, the Moon God is often referred to as 'Chandra', and the Goddess of the Moon is 'Chhaya'. Chayana is a beautiful name for a girl, evoking the mystical and nurturing qualities of the Moon Goddess. The name Chayana carries the meaning “Moon Goddess” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Chayana usually hope their child will grow to embody moon goddess and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name inspired by the Moon Goddess, symbolizing the nurturing, calming, and protective aspects of the divine feminine.
data.etymology: Chayana belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Moon Goddess.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Chayana total 8, giving a life-path number of 8. Number 8 is linked with Saturn and with the qualities of ambition, resilience and material success.

data.cultural_impact: The name Chayana carries a rich cultural heritage, as it is inspired by the ancient Sanskrit language and Hindu mythology. In Indian culture, the Moon is often associated with femininity, creativity, and the unconscious mind. Chayana's name sings a lyrical ode to the feminine divine and the enduring cycle of life and the natural world. It is a subtle yet powerful reminder of the influence the Moon and its feminine energies have on our life.
data.spiritual_significance: On a spiritual level, Chayana's name carries the essence of the Moon Goddess, who is a symbol of inner guidance, intuition, and emotional stability. The name implores us to look within ourselves for answers, to trust the wisdom of our inner voice, and to live in harmony with the natural rhythms and cycles of life. Chayana's name intones the harmonious symphony of the universe, resonating with the primordial creative energy that exists within each one of us.
data.spiritual_symbolism: Chayana, meaning 'she who carries the universe within herself', embodies the cosmic energy and inner wisdom that guides one's life journey. It reflects the belief in the interconnectedness of all things and the divine presence within each being.

historical_references.reference: Chayana was a celebrated poet and scholar during the Gupta Empire in the 5th century AD. He was a contemporary of the great king Harshavardhana and is known to have written several commentaries on works of the ancient Sanskrit grammarian Panini.

Chayana is also mentioned in the 12th century AD Sanskrit epic 'Mahabharata' as one of the sages who taught Dhritarashtra, the blind king, the art of dice playing before the great battle of Kurukshetra.
historical_references.context: Mahabharata, Teacher of Dice Playing to Dhritarashtra
